security_audit.summary: The skill is primarily a legitimate scientific presentation assistant, and many static alerts are false positives from markdown examples, LaTeX syntax, and design prose. Confirmed risks remain: the scripts send prompts and attached image data to OpenRouter, load API keys and .env files, write generated files, invoke subprocesses, and include a prior audit artifact that attempts to influence safety conclusions.

remediation.issue: External AI API requests can transmit prompts and attached research images.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear user-facing warnings before using Nano Banana Pro or OpenRouter, and require explicit consent before uploading local figures or unpublished data.

remediation.issue: API keys are accepted through command-line arguments and forwarded to a child process.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment variables or stdin over command-line secrets, and avoid passing API keys through subprocess argument lists.

remediation.issue: The dotenv loader searches parent directories for .env files.
remediation.suggestion: Limit dotenv loading to the current project or an explicit user-provided path to avoid unexpectedly ingesting unrelated secrets.

remediation.issue: The package includes EVALUATION_OUTPUT.json with prior audit conclusions.
remediation.suggestion: Remove generated audit artifacts from the published skill so they cannot influence reviewers or automated agents.

remediation.issue: Documentation references scripts through parent-directory paths.
remediation.suggestion: Replace ../document-skills paths with explicit dependency instructions or marketplace skill references that do not cross package boundaries.

content.value_statement: Scientific talks often fail when dense results are copied directly into slides. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan, design, generate, and validate clear research presentations.
actual_capabilities: Plans presentation structure for conferences, seminars, thesis defenses, journal clubs, and grant pitches.
Provides visual-first slide design guidance for typography, layout, color, accessibility, and data figures.
Includes LaTeX Beamer templates for conference, seminar, and defense presentations.
Documents workflows for PowerPoint creation using generated visuals and PPTX tooling.
Provides Python scripts for AI slide image generation, PDF assembly, PDF image conversion, and presentation validation.
Guides timing, rehearsal, slide count checks, and iterative visual review.
limitations: AI image generation requires an OpenRouter API key and sends prompts or attached images to an external service.
Generated slide images are not as editable as native PowerPoint or Beamer slides.
The skill depends on external tools such as Python packages, PDF utilities, pdflatex, or PPTX workflows for some outputs.
Scientific accuracy still depends on the user supplying correct data, citations, figures, and research context.

use_cases.title: Prepare a conference talk
use_cases.description: Turn a paper or result summary into a focused 10 to 20 minute talk with a clear story arc and readable visuals.

use_cases.title: Build a thesis defense deck
use_cases.description: Organize dissertation work into a complete narrative with methods, results, implications, backup slides, and timing guidance.

use_cases.title: Design grant or industry pitch slides
use_cases.description: Create persuasive slides that emphasize problem significance, feasibility, visual impact, and audience-specific outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a beginner research talk
prompt_templates.scenario: Start from topic, audience, and duration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a 15-minute scientific presentation about [topic] for [audience]. Create a slide-by-slide outline with timing, key message, and suggested visual for each slide.

prompt_templates.title: Convert paper results into slides
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this abstract and results summary to design a conference talk. Focus on 1-2 main findings, recommend figures, and identify where citations should appear.

prompt_templates.title: Create a visual design system
prompt_templates.scenario: Make an existing outline look professional.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this slide outline and propose a consistent design system: color palette, typography, layouts, figure treatment, section dividers, and accessibility checks.

prompt_templates.title: Run full presentation validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this presentation plan for narrative flow, timing, visual clarity, accessibility, data figure readability, and likely audience questions. Give a prioritized fix list.

output_examples.input: Plan a 12-minute conference presentation on a new protein design model.
output: A 12-slide talk outline with opening hook, background gap, methods overview, three result slides, implications, and final summary.
Timing guidance that reserves most time for results and leaves a buffer for transitions.
Visual suggestions for model architecture, benchmark comparisons, and failure cases.

output_examples.input: Improve my text-heavy methods slide for a thesis defense.
output: A redesigned slide concept with one main message, a process diagram, fewer words, larger typography, and color-coded stages.
Speaker-note guidance that moves detailed explanation out of the slide body.

output_examples.input: Check whether my 45-minute seminar deck is ready.
output: A review checklist covering slide count, pacing, figure readability, contrast, story continuity, backup slides, and rehearsal checkpoints.
A prioritized list of changes before final export.

best_practices: Start with the audience, talk length, and one core message before choosing slides.
Use strong visuals for every important idea, and keep text short enough to support spoken explanation.
Validate the final deck visually and rehearse with timing checkpoints before presenting.
anti_patterns: Copying paper figures or paragraphs directly into slides without simplifying them for projection.
Generating AI slides from vague prompts without a defined formatting goal and citation plan.
Uploading unpublished or sensitive research figures to external AI services without permission.

faq.question: Can this skill create both PowerPoint and Beamer presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides Beamer templates and PowerPoint-oriented workflow guidance, but native PowerPoint editing may require a separate PPTX skill.

faq.question: Does AI slide generation require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The included image generation scripts require an OpenRouter API key for Nano Banana Pro and review model requests.

faq.question: Will my figures be uploaded to an external service?
faq.answer: Yes, if you use the attachment workflow for AI generation. Attached images are encoded and sent to the external AI API.

faq.question: Can I use this for a thesis defense?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes structure, timing, and Beamer template guidance for dissertation or thesis defense presentations.

faq.question: Does the skill verify scientific accuracy?
faq.answer: No. It helps with presentation structure and design, but users must verify data, citations, claims, and scientific interpretation.

faq.question: What is the safest workflow for confidential research?
faq.answer: Use local Beamer or PowerPoint workflows, avoid external AI image generation, and do not attach confidential figures to third-party services.
